comment: Read from the source at tag v2.1.14 (commit 75e5f70), which is the installed build. The theme menu is left out of every other module in this plugin as plugin-wide decoration, but here the colour menu is the module, so it is written out. The maker's page says the three jacks take -10V to 10V for -100 to 100 per cent and are added as offsets; the code takes the voltage divided by ten, adds it, then takes the absolute value of the fractional part, so the colour wraps past full rather than clamping and a negative voltage folds back up instead of subtracting. The jacks are declared with a custom port widget that draws nothing and refuses drags, tooltips and its own menu while Toggle CV Inputs is off (greenscreen.cpp:414-443), so they exist in the census but cannot be used until that item is switched on. Colour changes are smoothed towards the target rather than applied at once (line 573-575).
